subject: Lane D HANDOFF: minimal causal proof package for next Fold7 first-open capture
body: Instrument one first-open and one subsequent attempt with exact identity and explicit gates. Highest-value current discriminator is cold SnapshotCache MISS -> capture fallback versus later HIT -> cached composition; this is not promoted as root cause. Surround accessibility takeScreenshot with ENTER/RETURN/CALLBACK, record display add/change/remove + engine generation, and record exception/process/service death. Continue through host/surface/presentation so downstream responsibility is visible in the same trace.
integration_minimum: Reuse TransitionLab.recordIngressStage; add structured currentGeneration + display facts.
Emit processEpoch/serviceEpoch before first opening; every attempt carries openingAttemptId.
Before framework takeScreenshot emit ACCESSIBILITY_CAPTURE_ENTER with displayId + engineEpoch + current display snapshot; emit RETURN at the call boundary and CALLBACK separately.
Emit DISPLAY_ADDED/CHANGED/REMOVED with engine creation/destruction epoch.
Emit uncaught exception/service destroy/process exit with exception class + top frame/stack hash.
Continue exact host/presentation receipts through FIRST_USEFUL_PRESENTATION.
Export trace completeness metadata: first/last sequence, gaps and dropped-event count.

decision_table.evidence: ENTER -> exception/death before RETURN; identity current
DISPLAY_REMOVED/engine retired -> ENTER on stale identity
R1 MISS fail, R2 HIT success, same process/service, upstream equal
decision_table.interpretation: cache branch first proven state divergence
cross-process recovery; no same-process warm-cache inference

field_claim: No physical fix/success claim. Current field blocker remains open.
